items.title: Unemployment benefit (ALG I) approval ends
items.quote: Die Bewilligung von Arbeitslosengeld wird deshalb ab diesem Tag aufgehoben (§ 48 Abs. 1 SGB X).
items.computation: The letter states the benefit is revoked starting the day employment begins, 01.09.2026, as printed in the heading ('Aufhebung der Bewilligung von Arbeitslosengeld ab 01.09.2026') and confirmed in the body text.

items.title: File Widerspruch (objection) against the revocation decision
items.quote: Er muss uns innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift erreichen (Agentur für Arbeit Musterbergen, Bahnhofstraße 12, 35037 Musterbergen).
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 27.08.2026, sent by ordinary post. Per § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X it counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Mon 31.08.2026 (no weekend shift applies to this deemed-delivery rule itself). The one-month objection period under § 84 SGG starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends one month later, on Wed 30.09.2026 (§ 188 Abs. 3 BGB). That day is a working day in NRW, so no further shift applies (§ 26 Abs. 3 SGB X). Confirmed by Ordnung's compute_deadline tool.

warnings: The letter states a payment 'für den August 2026' of 1.318,20 € but gives no specific payment date, so no due date could be computed for it; only the amount is recorded.

Deemed-delivery (4th day after posting) was assumed because the letter shows no proof of formal service (no yellow envelope / 'zugestellt am' date); if it was in fact served formally, the one-month objection period could start on a different, possibly earlier, date.
